thread:
Amy (CS): Heads-up: prepping economic-readiness for Aegis Health QBR next Wed. Need a finops snapshot, top 3 drivers for spend, and onboarding blockers. @Jordan (FinOps) can you own the spend forecast? cc @Morgan (AE) for renewal context.
Jordan (FinOps): On it. Can you share the latest usage window? Prefer last 30 days + any forecasted new seats. I'll run a quick seg by model type and embedding calls.
Amy (CS): Sending a short export to the secure link (internal): https://redwood.s3/exports/aegis-usage-2025-05.csv. Main spikes look tied to nightly embedding batches and an experimental debug job that wasn't rate-limited.
Mike (SE): We found a client-side retry loop causing duplicate embedding calls for some customers. PR to fix is up: https://git.redwood/pr/3421 — should cut duplicates.
Jordan (FinOps): Nice — if that lands before EOW that'll shave ~18% off embedding units in the optimistic forecast. I'll prepare two forecasts (conservative / optimistic). Any existing budget alert thresholds we should mirror?
Morgan (AE): Customer on annual renewal. Finance flagged a ~10% over-commit risk if current trend holds. They're evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted for cost predictability.
Amy (CS): For the QBR one-pager we need: MTD spend, forecast to EOM (two scenarios), top 3 cost drivers, recommended mitigations (batching, cache, client retry fix), and the ask (credits, temporary rate cap, or Dedicated eval).
Jordan (FinOps): I'll draft that by tomorrow. Also propose alert rules: soft alert at 12% above trailing-30-day avg, hard alert at 25%. Should notify AE + CS. Thoughts?
Amy (CS): Soft = 12%, hard = 25% sounds good. Make notifications email + slack to #cs-account-aegis and aegis-finance@aegis.com. Add runbook steps for immediate triage.
Jordan (FinOps): Will do. Runbook snippet will include the quick usage pull: `aws s3 cp s3://exports/aegis-usage-2025-05.csv - | jq -r \".rows[] | \[.ts,.model,.calls,.embeddings\] \"` and a checklist to seed prefix cache and escalate to SEs.
deploy-bot: alert-rule created for aegis: soft=12%, hard=25% -> channels: #cs-account-aegis, email:aegis-finance@aegis.com. (rule id: ar-2025-07-11-91)
Amy (CS): Perfect — also capture customer feedback: they asked for clearer unit metrics for embeddings per session. Add a bullet to the one-pager to request product doc updates and a short dashboard tile.
Mike (SE): I'll add that note and confirm ETA for client fix: EOD Friday. PR link again: https://git.redwood/pr/3421. If we need a quick hotfix release, I can coordinate with eng-releases.
Jordan (FinOps): I'll attach the two forecasts and a simple calc for the cost delta if they move to Dedicated (rough ballpark using current monthly usage * committed discount).
Amy (CS): Thanks all. Next steps: Jordan draft + alert creation (tomorrow), Mike client fix (EOD Fri), Amy assemble one-pager for QBR (Mon AM). Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
Morgan (AE): Copy — I'll prepare renewal talking points and budget ask to present on the QBR.
